// image-size: npm audit reports 18 high findings here, all one root cause: image-size@2.0.2,
pulled in by @docusaurus/mdx-loader. GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr (CVE-2025-71330, ICNS) and
GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq (CVE-2025-71329, JXL/HEIF) are both infinite-loop DoS, both
unpatched: range is <=2.0.2 and 2.0.2 is the last release. Upstream is archived
(github.com/image-size/image-size, no issues) and the maintainer has declined to fix.
No override is possible: mdx-loader calls the named async export `imageSizeFromFile`
from the `image-size/fromFile` subpath, which is 2.0-only. The `legacy` 1.2.1 tag has
no exports map and no fromFile entry (would hard-fail the build) and is in range anyway;
image-dimensions is ESM-only with a different API. Upstream fix is facebook/docusaurus
PR #12235, a breaking change slated for Docusaurus v4 — nothing lands on 3.x.
Exposure is nil: build-time only, and getLocalImageAbsolutePath returns early for
non-local URLs, so the only input is an image already committed to this repo. The
parsers dispatch on magic bytes and we ship zero icns/jxl/heif/heic/avif files.
Revisit with the Docusaurus v4 upgrade; track facebook/docusaurus#12231.
